free_tier.stated: 1 GB attachment storage per base on Free, with unlimited bases and 1,500 bases per workspace

egress.terms: Free; attachments served from airtableusercontent.com (CloudFront-fronted) with expiring signed URLs

tooling: Official Web API v0: POST /v0/{baseId}/{recordId}/{attachmentFieldId}/uploadAttachment accepts raw bytes up to 5 MB, larger files go via the content.airtable.com upload-then-attach flow
chaining: 1 GB x 1,500 bases x N workspaces = ~1.5 TB per free workspace as documented, multiplied by unlimited free workspaces. Pricing config also states 'unlimited bases' on Free; the 1,500 figure is the per-workspace cap. This is the single largest documented multiplicative figure in this area.
limits_note: 1,000 records per base on Free; 5 MB per direct API upload; 1,000 API calls per workspace per MONTH on Free; only 5 editor/creator collaborators; 1 GB per base is the billing-flag field maxTotalAttachmentSizeInBytes=1000000000
